content.title: What time will Chisora vs. Wilder start today?
content.text: How Deontay Wilder beat Derek Chisora on split decision in titanic heavyweight fightDeontay Wilder marked his 50th fight with a split-decision victory over Derek ChisoraDeontay Wilder beat Derek Chisora via split decision in his first career fight in London. Getty ImagesWilder beats Chisora via split decision in 50th career fightDeontay Wilder marked his 50th professional fight with a split-decision victory over Derek Chisora after 12 brutal rounds in London.The two veterans of the heavyweight decision traded countless blows and it was the American who shaded his British opponent, knocking him down twice while only being put down once himself.Two judges scored the fight in favour of Wilder (115-111 and 115-113) while the other scored it in favour of Chisora (115-112).After the fight, Wilder voiced his intention to follow up this evening's victory with a world title fight.Share your thoughts: live@theathletic.comSKIP ADVERTISEMENTAdvertisement If you know anything about boxing — or any combat sports — you will know that predicting the time of a main event is nothing but a fool's errand.The exact time of Chisora and Wilder's ring walks will only become clear once the last fight on the undercard is complete.That said, host broadcaster DAZN will start its coverage at 2pm EDT (7pm BST, 11am PDT), and have approximated that the fighters on the main event will walk out at around 5:26pm EDT (10:26pm BST, 2:26pm PDT).But please don't shout at us if it's any later than that!Welcome to our live coverage of Chisora vs. Wilder! Hello! And welcome along to The Athletic and our coverage of today's heavyweight fight between Derek Chisora and Deontay Wilder in London.Two of the biggest names in the sport over the last decade meet in what could be both of their last outings.Wilder hopes to continue his career after this evening's bout, while Chisora will hang up his gloves and is desperate to go out on a high!It is a busy night of boxing at the O2 Arena with a lively undercard, so stick with us throughout the evening.
